description: Inert OpenClaw gateway LaunchAgent and a live listener on the gateway port.
demo_beat: step 4 support - the unattended daemon and its listener
why: launchd enumerates every non-Apple job (937 down to 47 on a reference Mac; the exclusion is the platform vendor, not a catalog), and the gateway LaunchAgent is what finds OpenClaw here. The listener on 18789 is asserted as raw evidence only: the `ports` route is retired, because a listening port names an agent only when the process holding it already does.
